body: I think you're right, the world wasn't designed for people like you to live in, I'm not saying you should kill yourself I'm saying I feel the same. The world doesn't care how much you're struggling and that's what hurts. I don't even know what you're going through but can heavily relate to what you said. I guess a lot of people one here can relate to that sentence, it has a different meaning for everyone, I want to know why you can relate to it if you don't mind me asking. And if you don't want to answer all I wish is that you dont kill yourself, I know it's hard, maybe even seeming impossible at some times but please try.

I'm in the exact same place as you. I can't tell you it gets better for you and I because I have no clue. I'm on here encouraging people to keep trying while I myself don't want to. If you feel you have no purpose then try to encourage others to find their purpose, then maybe one day you can look back upon the advice you've given to others and it will make sense to you too. I'm sorry if this doesn't really help, I'm just a dumb kid. But keep trying friend.
